description: The pie chart presents the distribution of content categories for the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models,” showing 12 slices in total with labels and percentages connected by leader lines (no separate legend is visible). The slices are labeled AI/NLP Research (dark blue, 24.3%), Econ. & Fin. (teal, 18.4%), History (olive/brown, 8.2%), Game&Anime (brown/orange, 8.2%), Daily Life (light teal/gray-green, 7.1%), Med & Health (green, 6.7%), Science (blue-gray, 6.7%), Business (maroon, 5.9%), Pet & Animal (tan, 5.5%), Law (muted red/pink, 5.1%), Geography (yellow, 2.7%), and Math (light green, 1.2%). Percent values are shown next to the external labels rather than inside the wedges, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
